theorem lg_target {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : Set (α → β)) (s : Set α) [Finite ↑f] [Finite ↑s] : Finite ↑(f.seq s) := by
  have h : (f.seq s).Finite := by
    apply Set.Finite.image
    use fun g => g.seq s
    apply Set.Finite.map
    use fun g => g.seq s
    apply Set.Finite.sup
    exact Set.Finite.of_finite f
    exact Set.Finite.of_finite s
  exact h
